cases.prompt: Redraw <image1> in the anime visual language of <image2>: clean confident line work, bright flat color blocks with painterly cel-shaded shadows and delicate midtone transitions, luminous localized highlights, in a cool saturated palette of deep navy, crisp white and cool blues. Keep the established base quality, the reference's clear lines and painterly shading; do not bleach the skin, do not turn it photographic, do not over-sharpen. Choose a specific light for this scene: a cool daylight key entering from the large glass windows on the right, a soft warm bounce from the interior signage and the coffee, and a cool fill from the metal ceiling. On the face, place the cool key on the window-facing cheek, forehead and nose bridge, with a warm reflected fill lifting the shadow side, soft cheek blush and a small specular on the open eye; keep the winking eye as a clear one-eye-closed expression, the closed-mouth smile, and the cheek mole as identity marks. Build the long wavy reddish-brown hair as layered flowing masses: cool rim highlights along the window-side strands, warm subsurface glow on the shadowed waves, soft shadowed inner strands, not flat color. Render the navy-and-white striped top with crisp stripe construction, fabric folds catching cool key light and warm shadow. Draw the raised red-nailed hand with small specular highlights on the nails, and the clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw as a translucent volume: cool window highlights on the rim and lid, a warm amber glow through the liquid, soft refracted shadow on the fingers behind it. Layer the airport for depth: foreground chairs sharper with cool reflected color, the subject crisp and brightest, the glass wall, metal ceiling structure and distant terminal receding with lower contrast and cool atmospheric haze, small warm signage accents as depth cues. Keep neutral local color and cool environmental tone, no warm cast. A young woman with long wavy reddish-brown hair winks with one eye closed and smiles with closed lips, a small mole on her cheek, wearing a navy-and-white striped top, raising a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw in her red-nailed hand, seated among rows of airport terminal chairs beside large glass windows and a metal ceiling structure.

improvementsObserved: Clearer warm liquid transmission in coffee cup
More explicit cool reflection on hair edges
limitations: Brighter glass facade competes more with subject
Nose highlight and plane transition are harder

cases.prompt:
Redraw <image1> in the anime rendering language of <image2>, preserving the current result's effective face construction, wink, closed-mouth smile, cheek mole, hair mass, striped top, red nails, coffee cup and airport layout. Refine material and light-shadow integration with specific, scene-driven decisions:

Light source: overhead ceiling panels in the terminal act as the primary warm key, casting downward illumination that creates bright crown highlights on the hair, a lit band across the forehead and bridge of the nose, and warm top-lit surfaces on the shoulders and the upper rim of the cup. The large glass windows on the right provide a cool blue-green fill that lifts shadowed skin on the right cheek, neck and forearm, and tints the interior shadow of the hair mass with a cool violet undertone. Warm bounce from the iced coffee liquid reflects a soft amber glow onto the fingertips and the palm side of the gripping hand.

Shadow shapes: define a clear shadow shape under the chin, a cool-toned shadow pocket beneath the raised arm, and a deep shadow band inside the hair mass where strands overlap. Keep these shadows rich and cool, not lifted to flat midtones.

Highlight scale: hair receives narrow warm edge highlights along outer strands; skin receives broad soft gradient highlights on lit planes; the striped fabric shows crisp fold shadows with a subtle sheen on the white stripes; the transparent cup shows sharp specular glints on its rim and lid, a soft refraction distortion of the coffee liquid visible through the plastic wall, and a thin cool reflection line along the straw.

Spatial depth: foreground seats beside the subject keep defined edges and full contrast; midground seat rows soften progressively with reduced contrast and a slight cool haze; the far glass wall, ceiling trusses and flight signs recede with lower saturation and softer detail, pushing the subject forward. The background retains its existing structures without adding new objects.

A young woman with long wavy auburn hair, winking with one eye closed and a closed-mouth smile, small mole on her left cheek, wearing a navy-and-white horizontal striped top, holding up a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with red-painted nails, seated in an airport terminal with rows of gray seats, glass windows, and ceiling structure behind her.

improvementsObserved: More defined warm hair key versus cool shadow and window reflection
Clearer volumetric face shading, cup transmission and fabric fold hierarchy
Subject is separated more strongly from terminal
limitations: Blue fill on forearm is strong
CG remains more representational than flat illustrated styles

cases.prompt:
Redraw <image1> as a polished anime illustration in the visual language of <image2>, transferring how it is drawn, not what is depicted. Keep the clean confident lineart, soft anime face construction, smooth tonal skin shading with delicate blush, glossy warm hair sheen, and detailed drawn fabric. Preserve the wink, closed-mouth smile, cheek mole, red-brown wavy long hair, navy-and-white striped top, red-nailed fingers, clear iced-coffee cup, and airport seating/glass-window setting; do not import the reference's fangs, animal ears, clothing, or text.

Refine material and light so illumination genuinely acts on each surface: a coherent interior light creates lit and shadowed zones on the face, hair strands, hand, striped fabric, transparent cup, and airport structure, with local reflected color (warm bounce from the coffee, cool sky glow through the glass) rather than a global color grade. Build smooth light-to-shadow shape transitions on skin and hair, small warm-neutral specular accents on the hair coordinated with the red-brown tone, subtle highlights on nose tip, lower lip and cheek, and crisp red nail highlights. Render the striped top with drawn fold structure and midtone separation, not flat bands. Make the cup read as transparent plastic: show the coffee liquid inside, refraction, a straw, and bright rim highlights. Establish spatial layering: crisp luminous foreground subject, midground seat rows with mid detail, background windows and signage softer with lower contrast and atmospheric depth. Keep existing darks and midtones intact; do not whiten skin, flatten to photo, or over-sharpen. improvementsObserved: Less uniform warm cast in terminal background
Clearer coffee transparency and liquid refraction

cases.prompt:
Redraw <image1> in the rich, wet-material anime language of <image2>, keeping its saturated hue-organized shading and glossy reflective surfaces, while preserving the source identity, winking expression, closed-mouth smile, cheek mole, auburn wavy hair, striped top, red nails, coffee cup and airport setting. Do not copy the reference's green hair, uniform, twin-tails, vending machine or scene; transfer only how it is drawn and lit.

Choose one concrete lighting/color scheme: cool neutral daylight enters from the glass facade as the key, lighting the upper-right edges of hair, cheek, shoulder and cup with bright cool-lit rims; shadows lean to a cool blue-violet bounce from the glass, not flat gray; the yellow flight signs and the warm coffee cast a warm amber reflected light into the shadow side (chin, neck, inner hair strands, palm), creating a clear warm/cool contrast against the dark masses.

Render wet highlights with hue, not dead white: hair strands get narrow specular bands with a copper-amber core and a cool cyan edge; skin gets small dewy highlights on cheek, nose tip, lower lip and shoulder in warm peach, with soft pink blush and cool reflected fill in the shadowed cheek; the navy stripes get a glossy wet sheen with dappled mottled highlights echoing the reference's wet cloth, white stripes brighter; the transparent cup shows a refracted warm coffee gradient, a bright cool specular rim on the plastic, a cool lid reflection and a small warm caustic on the red-nailed fingers; red nails read as glossy lacquer with a single bright highlight each.

Build spatial hierarchy: sharp high-contrast subject in front, midground gray seats with softer edges and lower contrast, background glass wall, slatted ceiling and yellow signs receding with atmospheric depth and selective focus. Keep delicate midtone variation and material separation; do not bleach the skin, flatten it to a photo, uniformly tint the image cyan, brighten everything, add messy colored lights, or replace the reference's faithful face, face-shape and shadow-shape construction with a generic polished anime face.

A young woman with long auburn wavy hair winks with one eye closed and smiles with closed lips, a small mole on her cheek, wearing a navy-and-white striped top, raising a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw in red-nailed fingers, seated in an airport terminal with rows of gray seats, a glass facade and yellow flight-information signs.

improvementsObserved: More varied warm copper hair versus cool colored edge reflections
More visible cloth wet sheen, coffee transmission and spatial contrast

limitations: Dappled cloth sheen is coarse and can read like distressed fabric or sequins
Further refinement required before adopting as a shared method

cases.prompt:
Redraw <image1> fully in the drawing language of <image2>, using the current red-black anime result as the working base. Keep the established face construction, crisp thin painted edges, smooth planar skin shading, the winking lash-lined eye, the small angled nose mark, the defined closed-mouth red smile, and the cheek mole as identity marks; do not photo-smooth the skin and do not flatten into a hard-outlined orange-brown cartoon. Build the palette from the reference's dominant large red field and near-black hair/cloth mass, with gold only as small precise specular points, never a broad golden wash.

Choose one concrete light plan: a cool overhead airport key from the upper front. On the face it lights the forehead, nose bridge and lit cheekbone in a clean neutral midtone, while the shadow side, under-chin and neck fall into a cool shadow carrying a faint red bounce from the background, so the winking eye and mole sit in readable midtone, not flat white. On the hair the key draws one crisp gold-white specular band along the crown ridge; the outer locks read near-black in shadow with a thin red rim reflection where the ambient glow wraps them. On the raised hand the key catches knuckles and the tops of the red nails as tiny bright speculars; the translucent cup shows cool milky fill, a thin bright rim highlight on the upper edge, a soft red reflection on the lower glass, and the straw as a clean light line. On the striped top the navy stripes read deep, the white stripes catch a soft cool highlight, and folds get subtle shadow separation.

Layer the space: foreground figure crisp with strong focal contrast, midground seats and glowing yellow signage at medium contrast, background rows of seats and pedestrians pushed back with softened edges, lower contrast and a thin red atmospheric haze, ceiling slats converging. Keep existing darks and midtones intact. A young woman with long auburn wavy hair winks playfully with a closed-mouth smile, a small mole on her cheek, wearing a navy-and-white striped top and raising an iced coffee cup in an airport terminal.
